arxiv-1904-06750.title: From Theory to Systems: A Grounded Approach to Programming Language Education
arxiv-1904-06750.creator: Will Crichton
arxiv-1904-06750.description: Abstract I present a new approach to teaching a graduate-level programming languages course focused on using systems programming ideas and languages like WebAssembly and Rust to motivate PL theory. Drawing on students’ prior experience with low-level languages, the course shows how type systems and PL theory are used to avoid tricky real-world errors that students encounter in practice.

arxiv-2108-08586.title: Dynamics of a hybrid optomechanical system in the framework of the generalized linear response theory
arxiv-2108-08586.creator: B. Askari, A. Dalafi
arxiv-2108-08586.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by B. Askari, A. Dalafi. We present a theoretical study of the linear response of a driven-dissipative hybrid optomechanical system consisting of an interacting one-dimensional Bose–Einstein condensate (BEC) to an external time-dependent perturbation in the framework of the generalized linear response theory.

arxiv-2206-08183.title: Quantum mean states are nicer than you think: fast algorithms to compute states maximizing average fidelity
arxiv-2206-08183.creator: A. Afham, Richard Kueng, Chris Ferrie
arxiv-2206-08183.description: Abstract Fidelity is arguably the most popular figure of merit in quantum sciences. However, many of its properties are still unknown. In this work, we resolve the open problem of maximizing average fidelity over arbitrary finite ensembles of quantum states and derive new upper bounds.

arxiv-2206-14771.title: The role of electron polarization on nuclear spin diffusion
arxiv-2206-14771.creator: Alessandro Chessari, Samuel F. Cousin, Sami Jannin, Quentin Stern
arxiv-2206-14771.description: Abstract Dynamic nuclear polarization (DNP) is capable of boosting signals in nuclear magnetic resonance by orders of magnitude by creating out-of-equilibrium nuclear spin polarization. The diffusion of nuclear spin polarization in the vicinity of paramagnetic dopants is a crucial step for DNP and remains yet not well understood.

arxiv-2302-06993.title: Colossal reversible barocaloric effects in a plastic crystal mediated by lattice vibrations and ion diffusion
arxiv-2302-06993.creator: Ming Zeng, Carlos Escorihuela-Sayalero, Tamio Ikeshoji, Shigeyuki Takagi, Sangryun Kim, Shin-ichi Orimo, María Barrio, Josep-Lluís Tamarit, Pol Lloveras, Claudio Cazorla, Kartik Sau

Solid-state methods for cooling and heating promise a more sustainable alternative to current compression cycles of greenhouse gases and inefficient fuel-burning heaters.

arxiv-2305-04750.title: Sense, Imagine, Act: Multimodal Perception Improves Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Head-to-Head Autonomous Racing
arxiv-2305-04750.creator: Elena Shrestha, Chetan Reddy, Hanxi Wan, Yulun Zhuang, Ram Vasudevan
arxiv-2305-04750.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Elena Shrestha, Chetan Reddy, Hanxi Wan, Yulun Zhuang, Ram Vasudevan. Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) techniques have recently yielded promising results for real-world autonomous racing using high-dimensional observations. MBRL agents, such as Dreamer, solve long-horizon tasks by building a world model and planning actions by latent imagination. This approach involves explicitly learning a model of the system dynamics and using it to learn the optimal policy for continuous control over multiple timesteps.

arxiv-2311-12664.title: The DURel Annotation Tool: Human and Computational Measurement of Semantic Proximity, Sense Clusters and Semantic Change
arxiv-2311-12664.creator: Dominik Schlechtweg, Shafqat Mumtaz Virk, Pauline Sander, Emma Sköldberg, Lukas Theuer Linke, Tuo Zhang, Nina Tahmasebi, Jonas Kuhn, Sabine Schulte im Walde
arxiv-2311-12664.description: Abstract We present the DURel tool that implements the annotation of semantic proximity between uses of words into an online, open source interface. The tool supports standardized human annotation as well as computational annotation, building on recent advances with Word-in-Context models. Annotator judgments are clustered with automatic graph clustering techniques and visualized for analysis.

arxiv-2402-11684.title: ALLaVA: Harnessing GPT4V-Synthesized Data for Lite Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2402-11684.creator: Guiming Hardy Chen, Shunian Chen, Ruifei Zhang, Junying Chen, Xiangbo Wu, Zhiyi Zhang, Zhihong Chen, Jianquan Li, Xiang Wan, Benyou Wang Shenzhen Research Institute of Big DataThe Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen zhihongchen@link.cuhk.edu.cn , wangbenyou@cuhk.edu.cn https://github.com/Freed
arxiv-2402-11684.description: Abstract Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown premise in a broad range of vision-language tasks with their strong reasoning and generalization capabilities. However, they require considerable computational resources for training and deployment. This study aims to bridge the performance gap between traditional-scale LVLMs and resource-friendly lite versions by adopting high-quality training data.

arxiv-2411-00699.title: Algorithmic Transparency in Forecasting Support Systems
arxiv-2411-00699.creator: Leif Feddersen
arxiv-2411-00699.description: Abstract Most organizations adjust their statistical forecasts (e.g. on sales) manually. Forecasting Support Systems (FSS) enable the related process of automated forecast generation and manual adjustments. As the FSS user interface connects user and statistical algorithm, it is an obvious lever for facilitating beneficial adjustments whilst discouraging harmful adjustments.

arxiv-2512-19808.title: Quantum Phases of a Strongly Disordered Two-Legged Josephson Ladder
arxiv-2512-19808.creator: Eyal Walach, Efrat Shimshoni
arxiv-2512-19808.description: Abstract Disordered superconductors in low dimensions provide an exemplary manifestation for the role of quantum fluctuations in a many-body system. Specifically in Josephson arrays with comparable Josephson and charging energies ( E J ∼ E C E_{J}\sim E_{C} ), disorder tends to change the nature of the paradigmatic Superconductor-Insulator Transition (SIT) and potentially leads to formation of multiple distinct phases.

pmc-10582843.creator: Takahiro Sato, Shota Mizumoto, Midori Ota, Mayumi Shikano
pmc-10582843.description: ObjectiveTo comprehensively elucidate the current landscape of decentralised clinical trials (DCTs) and identify notable aspects that can facilitate DCT implementation.DesignCross-sectional analysis.SettingData were extracted using selected DCT-specific search terms on 4 June 2022, from the ClinicalTrials.gov database and on 2 September 2022, from the Japan Registry of Clinical Trials and Japic Clinical Trials Information.

pmc-10670090.title: Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging and Diffusion Tensor Imaging-Tractography in Resective Brain Surgery: Lesion Coverage Strategies and Patient Outcomes
pmc-10670090.creator: Vasileios Kokkinos, Athanasios Chatzisotiriou, Ioannis Seimenis, Takehiro Uda
pmc-10670090.description: Diffusion tensor imaging (DTI)-tractography and functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) have dynamically entered the presurgical evaluation context of brain surgery during the past decades, providing novel perspectives in surgical planning and lesion access approaches. However, their application in the presurgical setting requires significant time and effort and increased costs, thereby raising questions regarding efficiency and best use.

pmc-11310443.title: Oral microbiota diversity in moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, nail psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis
pmc-11310443.creator: Wen Fan, Na Lei, Yujie Zheng, Juan Liu, Xuechen Cao, Ting Su, Zhonglan Su, Yan Lu
pmc-11310443.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Gaining a comprehensive understanding of the role played by the oral microbiome in moderate to severe plaque psoriasis and its potential implications for disease management and development holds significant importance. With the objective of exploring correlations between the oral microbiota and severe psoriasis, this study involved 72 severe psoriasis patients and 16 healthy individuals, whose clinical manifestations and living habits were carefully recorded.

pmc-11329450.title: Utilizing Liquid–liquid phase separation-related lncRNAs to predict the prognosis and treatment response of PCa
pmc-11329450.creator: Jiangping Qiu, Cong Lai, Zhihan Yuan, Jintao Hu, Jiang Wu, Cheng Liu, Kewei Xu
pmc-11329450.description: BackgroundStudies have indicated a close association between genes linked to liquid–liquid phase separation (LLPS) and the progression of prostate cancer (PCa). However, the interplay among long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) linked to LLPS in PCa remains elusive. Therefore, we constructed a prediction model based on LLPS-related LncRNA in PCa to explore its relationship with the prognosis and drug treatment of PCa.

pmc-11703696.title: Injuries from blank cartridge shots in suicide attempts within the South Korean military: a case series of five patients
pmc-11703696.creator: Jeong Il Joo, Changsin Lee, Kyungwon Lee
pmc-11703696.description: PurposeBlank cartridges are designed to produce the sound and gas flare of a gunshot without firing a bullet. However, blank cartridge shots (BCS) can still cause injuries ranging from minor to life-threatening. Within the South Korean military, most BCS-related injuries have occurred during suicide attempts.

pmc-11704222.title: Relationships of Thickness of Perirenal Fat with Urinary Levels of MCP-1 and NGAL in Patients with Hypertension
pmc-11704222.creator: Anna Bragina, Yulia Rodionova, Konstantin Osadchiy, Daria Bayutina, Maria K. Vasilchenko, Alexander Fomin, Valeriy Podzolkov
pmc-11704222.description: BackgroundWe conducted a study to determine the relationships between perirenal fat (PRF) thickness and urinary levels of monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 (MCP-1) and neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin (NGAL) in patients with hypertension (HTN).MethodsIn 338 HTN patients (aged 63.5±12.3 years on average), MCP-1 and NGAL levels were studied using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). To measure PRF thickness, all patients underwent CT scans.

pmc-13331682.title: Rational design and synthesis of dicyanovinylene–umbelliferone as an effective water indicator for organic solvents
pmc-13331682.creator: Seda Cinar, Ebru Aktan, Zeynel Seferoğlu
pmc-13331682.description: An umbelliferone structure has been synthesized as an efficient water probe based on the ICT effect through a D–π–A system. Rationally designed probe 5 has a hydroxyl group as an electron donor (D) and a dicyanovinylene group as an electron acceptor (A) unit representing the smaller molecular structure compared to other water sensors larger in molecular size.
